title: Bird community line-transect distance sampling in seven distance bands, 8 transects x 19 surveys, Mudumalai and Upper Nilgiris, Tamil Nadu, India, 1995-1996 (without IUCN-threatened species, coordinates as published)
creator: Raman, T. R. Shankar
citation: Raman, T. R. S. (2024). Line transect data on birds from Mudumalai and Upper Nilgiris, India [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.10540410
abstract: Variable-width line-transect surveys of bird communities in 1995-96 in the Mudumalai Wildlife Sanctuary (now Tiger Reserve) and the Upper Nilgiris, Tamil Nadu, India, on a project of the Centre for Ecological Sciences, Indian Institute of Science. Eight 1,200 m transects in eight habitat strata (shola, grassland, wattle, eucalyptus, coffee and teak plantations, dry and moist deciduous forest) were walked one to four times in the first three hours after sunrise; all birds seen or heard were recorded to species with number and perpendicular distance band.
samplingProtocol: 1,200 m line transects walked at a slow uniform pace in the first 3 h after sunrise (about 100-120 min); every bird seen or heard recorded with number and perpendicular distance in bands 0-5, 5-10, 10-15, 15-20, 20-30, 30-50, 50-100 m (wider with distance). Methods as in Raman (2001, PhD thesis, IISc) and Raman (2003).
closureNote: occasion (bands of one walk); period = repeat visit
geographicCoverage: Mudumalai Wildlife Sanctuary and Upper Nilgiris, Nilgiris district, Tamil Nadu, India (transect coordinates as published, 500 m uncertainty in __units)

coordinatesCoarsened.method: As published (500 m uncertainty): the IUCN-threatened Anthus nilghiriensis are not in this table (E7.3)

notes: Community distance sampling: a 0 row for every species x band at every survey. Heard-only detections are included with their recorded band, as the source does. Transects were visited 1-4 times; period is the visit index, so most units have fewer than 4 periods. Teppakkadu Dry Deciduous Forest is listed with two coordinate pairs, one per field season: 1995-12-16 11.585462, 76.586046; 1996-05-12 11.585462, 76.586046; 1996-05-13 11.585550, 76.577724; __units carries the first.

notShipped.beyond_100m: 3 detections recorded beyond 100 m (bands 100-125, 100-150, >100), outside the band scheme
notShipped.ambiguous_band: 1 detection in a 20-50 band that spans two scheme bands
notShipped.per_detection_fields: heardSeenFlying, leftRight, mixedFlock, location and remarks are per detection and do not survive aggregation to band counts
notShipped.threatened species: Anthus nilghiriensis: in raman_2024_nilgiris_birds_ds only, whose coordinates are coarsened
